subject: Decision path & hosting/SLA clarifications — Mednova
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + clarifying asks from today's call

Olivia — thanks again for your time today. Short recap and a few clarification items so we can get the right materials to your team before next week:

- Economic buyer / decision owner: you mentioned Mark Li (VP Engineering). Can you confirm whether procurement will route contracts through Finance or directly via Legal?
- Security requirements: you flagged PHI considerations and a preference for network isolation. Our standard offering options are Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved GPU pool with private VPC peering), and Private (customer-managed on-prem/VPC). Please confirm which deployment mode Mednova favors for initial pilot (Dedicated vs Private).
- Performance targets: during the call Mark said target latency for end-to-end P95 is ~200ms for ~512-token responses. Can you confirm P50/P95 targets and a sample payload size distribution?
- Budget / unit economics: you mentioned an internal target to keep inference spend under a specific threshold. Would it be fair to capture that as an approximate cost per million tokens or a monthly committed spend range?
- Timeline & procurement: you estimated procurement review in ~3–4 weeks. Do you have a cutover date or go-live window for the pilot?

Next steps from our side:
- We will send SOC2 report and a short architecture note for Dedicated vs Private that maps to your PHI/residency ask.
- Ben will prepare a cost delta (Dedicated vs Private) based on a throughput profile — please confirm expected QPS and average token per request so the estimate is accurate.
- Marissa (Legal) will draft an initial SLA and highlight common redlines so procurement has something to start with.

Proposed follow-up: a 30–45m alignment with Procurement + Security + Mark on Wed 2027-07-28 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work?

Attachments: I uploaded the vendor questionnaire you shared to the thread (filename: Mednova_vendor_questionnaire_2027-07-22.pdf).

Thanks — we want to make the pilot low friction.

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mednova.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@mednova.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@mednova.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + clarifying asks from today's call

Hi Nikhil — thanks for the clear summary. A few points to confirm from our side:

- Decision owner: Mark Li (VP Eng) will sign off on technical fit; CFO (Annette Wright) will own commercial approval. Procurement will coordinate contract reviews with Legal.
- Deployment preference: for the pilot we prefer Dedicated with VPC peering if possible, but if Private (customer-managed) is materially more secure/cost-effective we can consider it. PHI is a hard constraint — data must remain in US regions only.
- Latency targets: target P95 <= 200ms for 256–512 token lifecycle (end-to-end). P50 target ~60–80ms. We will send a small sample of payloads to help sizing.
- Throughput: expected baseline ~20 QPS for initial pilot, bursting to 60 QPS on weekdays. Average tokens per request ~180.
- Budget: procurement is aiming for a monthly committed spend under $40k for the pilot phase.
- Security deliverables: procurement requests SOC2 Type II report, recent pen-test summary, and a description of logging/egress controls (how long logs are retained, access controls).
- Contract timeline: procurement review typically takes 4–6 weeks; legal redlines may take longer depending on SLA changes.

Yes to Wed 7/28 10:00 AM PT for an alignment call — Mark and a member of procurement will join. Please include your Solutions/Infra engineer on that call.

Attachment: I attached Mednova_vendor_questionnaire_2027-07-22.pdf with more detail on compliance questions.

Olivia Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Mednova Health
olivia.park@mednova.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mednova.com>
Date: 2027-07-23T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Mednova — asks & owners (prep for 7/28)

Team — looping you in with the asks from Mednova so we can come prepared on 7/28. Action items below; target deliverables by EOD Mon 7/26 so I can consolidate and send ahead of the call.

Ben (costs):
- Please produce a 1-page cost comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for the stated profile (baseline 20 QPS, burst 60 QPS, avg 180 tokens/request). Include model assumptions, steady-state vs burst pricing, and a committed monthly spend option that hits roughly <$40k/month for pilot.

Laura (solutions/infra):
- Prepare a short architecture note (1–2 pages) that explains Dedicated (VPC peering) and Private (customer-managed) flows, including: data residency controls, logging/egress options, KV cache behavior, and how we implement tenant isolation for PHI. Please include expected P95 numbers for 256/512 token responses on the hardware profile we discussed (A100-class inference).

Marissa (legal):
- Draft a clean initial SLA and call out three typical redline items procurement flags (data residency, uptime SLOs, liability caps). Also confirm whether we can provide SOC2 report and the usual NDA/DSA language.

Attachments to include in the outbound: SOC2_report_Redwood_Q2_2027.pdf, preliminary SLA_draft_Redwood_v1.docx, and the solutions note. I have uploaded the Mednova questionnaire they sent.

If you want to split the work, Ben/Laura pair to produce the one-pager + solutions note; Marissa will produce the SLA redline memo. I'll take point on sending everything to Olivia and Mark, and will book the 7/28 slot.

--
Nikhil

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@mednova.com>, Mark Li <mark.li@mednova.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Decision path & hosting/SLA clarifications — Mednova (materials + meeting)

Olivia / Mark — thanks again. Confirming next steps and what we'll send before the 7/28 alignment call:

1) Documents (attached):
   - SOC2_report_Redwood_Q2_2027.pdf (SOC2 Type II, controls summary)
   - SLA_draft_Redwood_v1.docx (initial SLOs and common redlines called out)
   - Dedicated_vs_Private_solutions_note.pdf (architecture, data residency, logging/egress controls, expected P95 guidance for 256/512 tokens)
   - Cost_comparison_pilot.xlsx (Hosted / Dedicated / Private estimates keyed to your 20QPS baseline and 60QPS burst)

2) Items we'll discuss on 7/28 (10:00 AM PT):
   - Confirm decision owner and procurement timeline; identify any additional stakeholders (Legal, InfoSec).
   - Review PHI/data residency constraints and chosen deployment mode (Dedicated vs Private).
   - Walk through cost assumptions and committed spend options to land under the ~$40k/month pilot target.
   - SLA SLOs: propose P95 latency SLO of 200ms for 512-token responses for Dedicated deployment; discuss uptime SLOs and liability limits.

3) Ask from Mednova before the call: please share the sample payloads (anonymized) and a short note that confirms whether logs need to be retained for >90 days and whether egress to third-party analytics vendors is allowed.

Calendar invite: https://cal.example.com/event?eid=abc123
DocuSign (optional sample SLA): https://docusign.example.com/rooms/xyz789

If that looks good I'll send the materials to Procurement + Legal and add Ben/Laura/Marissa to the meeting invite.

Best —
Nikhil Sharma

nikhil@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
